title: "Sarah Anne Mercier (probable author) - Mrs Filby's Maria"
book_id: 787

## Publication Information

**Date:** 1871?

**Imprint:** London: Warne

**Notes:** This work, of which no copy has been traced, appeared in Warne's Victoria Tales and Stories series, edited by CMY, and was reviewed in <i>MP</i> (April 1871), 418.  A reference to it in a letter to Anne Mercier suggests that it was written by her.
